summary: Synthetic replay of Mandate and instrument intake; illustrates the workflow contract, not a real investment assessment.

findings.statement: Turn the investor request into a specific research mandate without inventing climate objectives.

mandate_contract.financial_objective: Compare scenario financial exposures; synthetic research demonstration only.
mandate_contract.climate_objective: Financial risk integration, with climate contribution reported separately; no net-zero or exclusion mandate imposed.
mandate_contract.investment_horizon: 5 years; longer climate horizons considered qualitatively
mandate_contract.benchmark: No benchmark supplied; no relative-return claim
mandate_contract.constraints: No trading; no actual allocation; no public certification or external communications.

assumptions: All companies, securities and numerical paths are fictional demo inputs.
uncertainties: No semantic model-output evaluation or live-source validation has been performed.

confidence.basis: Fixed demonstration value; not a model-derived confidence or empirical calibration.
